policies.termsSubtitle: Official rules and codes of honor for the 100-player arena.
policies.antiCheatSubtitle: Zero tolerance for unfair play. Server-authoritative fair gaming.

terms.section1Desc: 100 players compete in real-time speed quiz rounds. One wrong answer or timeout results in instant elimination. The last player standing claims ultimate glory.
terms.section2Desc: Guest login allows rapid match entry. Offensive, hateful, or abusive callsigns are strictly forbidden and subject to instant blacklisting.
terms.section3Desc: All question timers, round sync, and tie-breakers are validated by the central server. Millisecond response times determine top positions in case of equal scores.
terms.section4Desc: Cards, offensive abilities, and defensive shields must be executed in accordance with class cooldowns. Misuse or desync exploits are automatically rejected.

antiCheat.section1Desc: All question payloads, correct answers, and countdown states are calculated server-side with NestJS and Redis. The client never holds answer keys.
antiCheat.section2Desc: Heuristic latency tracking, automated click-pattern analysis, and input frequency monitors immediately detect non-human automated response scripts.
antiCheat.section3Desc: Use of memory scanners, browser extension injection, WebSocket packet tampering, or screen-reading OCR bots is strictly prohibited.
antiCheat.section4Desc: Any confirmed cheating attempt triggers immediate expulsion from the match, nullification of leaderboard ratings, and permanent IP/device ban.
